rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The issue's report opens: '[B]JP National Working President Shri JP Nadda was elected unopposed as the 11th National President of BJP' (the drop cap is lost in the text layer).

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same sentence says that Shri JP Nadda 'took charge from the outgoing Party National President and Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah on 20 January, 2020'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The report says the senior leaders arrived at the headquarters 'on 20 January, 2020' before the filing of nominations, that 'Shri Nadda's name was proposed by the senior party leaders, including outgoing National President and Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah', and that 'Shri JP Nadda remained the only candidate for the top post'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: After verification 'a formal announcement regarding Shri JP Nadda's election as President was made in the afternoon'; 'The election in-Charge and former Union Minister Shri Radha Mohan Singh made the official declaration of the election'.
